load.missing: The arcade route packages are not in this workspace yet. Initialise {{packs}} from the OB data first.
load.failed: Could not read the arcade route data: {{message}}
load.emptyCourseTable: The course table has no rows to use as a template.
load.noWorkspace: Open an EXVS2 Workspace folder first.
load.initialise: Unpack them from the OB data
load.initialiseFailed: Could not unpack the route packages: {{message}}
load.missingTitle: Arcade route data is not unpacked yet
load.sourceMissing: No OB dplcache folder is set — set it in Config, or use FHM2D Init.

repack.buttonHint: Check which mission packages the game is still missing
repack.title: Repack mission packages
repack.description: Saving writes the workspace folders; the game reads .fhm2d packages. This is every mission package and where each one stands against the mod folder.
repack.noModFolder: No OB Mod folder is set. Set it in Config before repacking.
repack.planning: Comparing the workspace against the mod folder…
repack.planFailed: Could not build the repack list: {{message}}
repack.allCurrent: Every mission package is up to date
repack.note: Each package is written into the mod folder as <hash>.fhm2d, replacing what is there. The tables are what decide whether a stage exists at all: repacking only the briefing and the script leaves a new course invisible in game.

browser.title: Routes
browser.search: Filter by name or course id
browser.dormantHint: These scenes ship with a script and a briefing but no course plays them. Claiming one is the safest way to add a route: nothing new has to be hashed.
browser.dormantEmpty: Every shipped scene is already used by a course.
browser.unsavedCourse: unsaved — press Save to write it

wizard.title: New route from unused scenes
wizard.description: Give the scenes a course entry so the arcade select screen offers them.
wizard.courseIdHint: The server decides which course ids are offered. Unused ids above 250 are the usual choice.
wizard.name: Display name
wizard.nameHint: Shown on the select screen. ASCII only, for example A-22.
wizard.sceneNumberHint: Results are reported to the server per scene number, so a fresh range keeps them separate.
wizard.cloneTitle: New course cloned from an existing one
wizard.cloneDescription: Mints brand-new scenes: each stage gets its own folder, named here and hashed from that name.
wizard.sceneNamesHint: One folder per stage, up to {{max}}. The name is the only input — the scene key and the script package hash are both derived from it, so the shipped rule 000triad_battle_<cat><NNN>_<MMM> keeps a custom route consistent with the game's own naming.
wizard.sceneNameInvalid: Use ASCII letters, digits, '_' or '-' only, up to 64 characters.
wizard.sceneNameDuplicate: Two stages cannot share a folder name.
wizard.sceneNameCountMismatch: The number of scene names does not match the number of stages.
wizard.created_one: Created {{count}} scene on disk. The course row is written when you save, and only then does it join the list on the left.
wizard.created_other: Created {{count}} scenes on disk. The course row is written when you save, and only then does it join the list on the left.
wizard.categoryHint: A-F only: the briefing has NumA..NumF and hides anything else.
wizard.stageCountHint: One new folder per stage. Asking for more stages than the donor has repeats its stages as starting points.
wizard.shapeFClass: F-class courses play one stage and the checker blocks anything else; this one has {{count}}.
wizard.shapeNonF: Every shipped A-E course plays {{expected}} stages; this one has {{count}}. The checker blocks anything else: a course that runs out of stages crashes the game.

course.title: Course {{name}}
course.description_one: The select-screen row for the whole course: name, id, variant and stars. It covers its {{count}} stage and does not change with the stage picked below.
course.description_other: The select-screen row for the whole course: name, id, variant and stars. It covers all {{count}} stages and does not change with the stage picked below.
course.name: Name
course.variantHint: Several rows may share a course id; the variant tells them apart. Opening an existing row is not a clash.
course.unlockServerHint: Type 0 appears only if the server lists it. That is the shipped default.
course.displayUnitsHint: The four suits the course list shows next to this course. They are the course's montage, not one stage's opponents — those live on each stage's loading screen.
course.displayUnitNoStage: No stage of this course fields this suit
course.unlockLocked: This course uses unlock type {{type}}, which has not been decompiled. The field is read-only so the shipped behaviour is preserved.

stages.title: Stages
stages.scriptFolderUnknown: This stage has no official scene name, so the unpack folder cannot be named yet.
stages.scriptFolderUnpacked: This package is unpacked in the workspace.
stages.scriptFolderMissing: This package is not unpacked yet. Use Unpack this stage's script in this row.
stages.openScript: Open script in the MSC workspace
stages.scriptNotRead: The mission script has not been read, so the fight and the briefing cannot be compared.
stages.scriptLoadFailed: The mission script could not be read: {{message}}
stages.scriptLoaded: Read {{count}} unit slot(s) from the mission script.
stages.reextractScriptBody: Replace the files for {{name}} in {{path}} from the OB package. Decompiled .c files beside them are left in place.

editor.emptyBody: Pick a course on the left, or claim a group of unused scene slots.

extend.title: Add stages to {{name}}
extend.description: Clone the mission script and briefing into new scene folders for the missing fights. Names follow the official rule from stage 1.
extend.saveNote: Files are written to the workspace immediately. Save and repack before the game will play the new stages.
extend.needScriptFolder: Unpack the donor stage's script folder first.
extend.replaceExisting: Overwrite the files an earlier run left for {{scenes}}. Only that scene's own script folder and briefing are rewritten; ids held by any other scene stay untouched.

squad.title: Line-up
squad.description: Generate the fight and the briefing that shows it.
squad.enemyCountHint: Hardware testing put the on-screen ceiling at {{max}} enemies.

slots.title: Unit slots
slots.empty: No slots yet. Generate a line-up first.
slots.deadParameterNote: Eleven of the slot parameters are never read by this build, so the editor does not expose them.

briefing.title: Stage {{index}} loading screen
briefing.description: What this stage's briefing draws before the fight starts. It does not change what spawns.
briefing.drawnHint_one: The screen holds eight portraits; this stage spawns {{count}} unit across all waves.
briefing.drawnHint_other: The screen holds eight portraits; this stage spawns {{count}} units across all waves.
briefing.drawnFromNoSlot: No battle slot spawns this suit.
briefing.castTitle_one: Cast ({{count}} suit the screen can draw)
briefing.castTitle_other: Cast ({{count}} suits the screen can draw)
briefing.castEmpty: This briefing lists no suits, so the screen stays blank.
briefing.syncFromSquad: Match the briefing to the line-up
briefing.syncFromSquadHint: Rebuild the cast and the per-slot list from what the script spawns, keeping the pilots and boss frames.
briefing.castPadding_one: {{count}} more zeroed entry keeps the file's original length.
briefing.castPadding_other: {{count}} more zeroed entries keep the file's original length.

validation.title: Checks
validation.clean: Every check that could run passed.
validation.blocked: {{count}} problem(s) must be fixed before saving.
validation.subtitle: Reported, never repaired - what to change is your call.
validation.idleSubtitle: Open a route to check it.
validation.idle: No route is open, so nothing has been checked yet.
validation.notCheckedBody: No complete reference list ships for {{lists}}, so those checks were skipped rather than guessed.
validation.ready: This route has nothing that needs fixing.

order.title: Order of category {{letter}}
order.description: The select screen groups by category and lists each one by its course number, which is not the number in the name. Top to bottom here becomes 1..N.
order.blockedByEdits: Save or drop the unsaved edits to {{courses}} first — reordering writes the course table directly and those edits would put the old numbers back.
order.done: Renumbered {{count}} course(s). Repack the course table to see it in game.

save.donePartial: Wrote {{count}} file(s); {{unchanged}} were already identical and left alone. Originals kept as .bak.
save.doneUnchanged: Nothing to write: all {{count}} file(s) already match the route.
save.blocked: Fix the problems listed under Checks first.
save.packsDirty: Repack {{packs}} to put the route in the game.
save.previewDescription: Nothing has been written yet. Every file listed here is replaced in one go, and only if all of them can be produced.
save.unchangedCount_one: {{count}} identical to what is on disk
save.unchangedCount_other: {{count}} identical to what is on disk
save.backupNote: Each replaced file keeps its pre-edit bytes in a .bak sibling, written once and never overwritten.
